articles.title: Even Josh Allen wanted answers from Hailee Steinfeld about Avengers, and her revelation makes the story more intriguing
articles.summary: Josh Allen is waiting on a Marvel answer from his wife, just like the rest of the internet.
articles.body: Josh Allen is waiting on a Marvel answer from his wife, just like the rest of the internet. Hailee Steinfeld told Jimmy Fallon on The Tonight Show this week that Allen called her recently to ask if she is in Avengers: Doomsday. Her reply to Fallon's follow-up question was neither a yes nor a no. The Bills quarterback has his own business to handle after a messy 24-16 win over the Chargers kept Buffalo at 3-0, but he is clearly as curious about her next big role as any fan.Josh Allen asked Hailee Steinfeld if she is in Avengers: DoomsdayBy her own account, yes. Steinfeld said her husband "called me the other day and was like, 'Are you in this?'" The line works because she has dealt with the same question since the Sinners premiere in April 2025. Fans want to know whether Kate Bishop, her Hawkeye character, will turn up in the film. Either she is dodging her own husband, or she truly does not know yet. For a quarterback who spends his Sundays making defenses guess, being left guessing is a nice twist.Fallon pressed her on it. Steinfeld answered, "I actually have no idea. Time will tell," which leaves the door open without stepping through it. She is no stranger to Marvel. Beyond Hawkeye on Disney+, she voices Gwen in both Spider-Verse films. Her newsletter added a small wrinkle. In Beau Society, she wrote about bumping into Florence Pugh backstage between talk shows. Pugh is confirmed for Doomsday as Yelena Belova, and she is busy promoting East of Eden. Steinfeld said she wants to have Pugh on for an issue. A backstage hello proves nothing, but Marvel fans will happily read into it.What is Hexed, Hailee Steinfeld's next movie, about?Hexed is a Disney animated feature that reaches theaters on November 25. Steinfeld voices Billie Doe, a teenage oddball who finds out she has magic powers. Rashida Jones voices her Type-A mom, with Jodie Foster and Walton Goggins also in the cast. The film carries extra weight for her. At D23 last month, she told Access Hollywood, "This is the first project I've been working on since I had my baby." She and Allen welcomed daughter Harper Haize this offseason, so telling a mother-daughter story clearly means a lot to her.Allen has his own storylines this week too. The Chargers game brought five turnovers and 10 penalties, and he appeared to hurt his left knee on a run. Coach Joe Brady said on September 30 that he is not concerned, and Allen was a full participant in practice that day. Steinfeld, asked on Fallon whether the couple is superstitious about the 3-0 start, borrowed one of Allen's favorite lines from The Office: "We're a little 'stitious, you know? How can you not be?" articles.title: Wild Cowboys-Steelers Trade Stat Goes Viral After Joey Porter Jr.'s Contract Saga Comes to an End
articles.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers are getting back a piece of what they traded to acquire wide receiver George Pickens after sending out cornerback Joey Porter Jr.
articles.body:
The Pittsburgh Steelers are getting back a piece of what they traded to acquire wide receiver George Pickens after sending out cornerback Joey Porter Jr.

The Steelers are trading Porter to the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick and 2028 second-round selection, per ESPN's Todd Archer .

Archer and Sports Illustrated 's Albert Breer noted the 2027 sixth-rounder was previously part of the deal that brought Pickens from the Cowboys to the Steelers.

Pickens was traded to the Cowboys in May 2025 alongside a 2026 sixth-rounder. The Cowboys received a 2026 third-rounder alongside the 2027 sixth-rounder in return.

The Steelers later used that third-round pick to draft quarterback Drew Allar.

That's not the only recent deal that's been completed between the Cowboys and Steelers. The Cowboys also sent a 2027 third-rounder and 2027 sixth-rounder in exchange for offensive tackle Broderick Jones and a 2027 fourth-round pick.

Pickens, Broderick and Porter were each selected in the top two rounds of the 2022 or 2023 drafts.

The Steelers are stocking up on draft picks by moving them, but not getting back selections in those top rounds. Of the nine picks the Steelers are projected to hold in the 2027 draft, per Tankathon , the franchise only has two of their own picks in Rounds 1 and 2.

The three picks the Steelers have received from the Cowboys, as well as the one selection the franchise got from the Miami Dolphins in the Jalen Ramsey trade, are coming in rounds three through seven.

The Cowboys are now projected to have just four 2027 draft picks, including a single selection of their own, per Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

Porter had yet to play this season amid what the team reported was a lingering back injury coinciding with his stalled extension negotiations with the Steelers. DLLS' Clarence Hill Jr . reported Porter will be available to make his Cowboys debut Sunday as a foil for Houston Texans wideout Nico Collins depending on the status of his back.

In the aftermath of the surprise trade sending him to the Dallas Cowboys, Joey Porter Jr. shared a message that fans of his new team will appreciate.

On his Instagram Story, Porter posted a "seat belt" meme that defines it as "the opposing receiver is locked up" along with a caption "here I come Dallas" and a heart emoji.

Porter had been in a contract standoff with the Pittsburgh Steelers since the offseason. He also sat out the first three games of the season what what the team initially listed as a back injury and later changed to not injury related/conditioning.

The Steelers listed Porter as a full practice participant on Monday and Tuesday this week as they prepare to play the Cleveland Browns on Thursday Night Football.

Steelers general manager Omar Khan told reporters on Aug. 31 the team held Porter in high regard, but they wouldn't going to break from their usual practice of not negotiating extensions after the season starts.

Per NFL insider Jordan Schultz , the Cowboys don't plan on immediately extending Porter.

The Cowboys, whose defensive struggles from last season have so far carried over into 2026, used some of their extra draft capital by sending Pittsburgh a 2027 sixth-round pick and 2028 second-round pick to add Porter to the secondary.

Dallas has the second-worst pass defense in the NFL by EPA per pass at 0.37, ahead of only the Miami Dolphins (0.47). The Cowboys also rank last in defensive success rate at 54.4 percent.

Given the resources Dallas has invested on that side of the ball in the past 12 months, including trading for Quinnen Williams and using two first-round picks in this year's draft on Caleb Downs and Malachi Lawrence, the lack of success so far is not a good look for anyone.

Porter, who had 14 passes defensed and didn't allow a touchdown in coverage last season, should be a huge boost for the Cowboys defense as soon as he is able to get on the field.

Dallas travels to Houston for a matchup with the Texans on Sunday, then has a quick turnaround to host the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Thursday Night Football in Week 5.

articles.title: Joey Porter Jr. Traded to Cowboys for NFL Draft Picks Following Steelers Contract Standoff
articles.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers haved moved on from starting cornerback Joey Porter Jr. after stalled extension negotiations.
articles.body:
The Pittsburgh Steelers haved moved on from starting cornerback Joey Porter Jr. after stalled extension negotiations.

The Dallas Cowboys confirmed the deal for Porter on Thursday morning after Tom Pelissero of The Ringer first reported the move on Wednesday night.

According to Adam Schefter of ESPN, there's "a chance" Porter will play Sunday against the Houston Texans after the deal.

Despite the trade, the Cowboys don't plan to sign Porter to an extension immediately and will instead play out the year on his current deal, per NFL Insider Jordan Schultz .

Porter, who has not yet played this season, is under a $4.9 million cap hit in the final year of his rookie contract .

The Steelers attempted to finalize an extension for Porter this offseason but did not come to resolution before the franchise's Week 1 negotiating deadline, which general manager Omar Khan told reporters in August the franchise did not plan to change.

Porter was placed on the PUP list in early August after reportedly aggravating a back injury. Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said later that month the team was at an "impasse" in contract negotiations with Porter.

The cornerback ultimately missed the first three games for the Steelers before he was traded without having played a snap in 2026.

The news comes after Schefter reported the Cowboys had joined teams including the Detroit Lions in making inquiries about Porter.

The Cowboys ultimately won that potential bidding war as part of the team's ongoing effort to overhaul its defense.

Dallas started last season by acquiring Kenny Clark and Quinnen Williams, then added Rashan Gary before drafting Caleb Downs and Malachi Lawrence last spring.

The Cowboys will now continue that effort by addressing the secondary, which struggled early this season after losing Cobie Durant to injury.

Dallas will hope adding more pass protection will help the team improve on a 1-2 start to the season.

Porter missed three games due to injuries last season, including two with a hamstring issue and one with a hip injury.

When available he recorded 52 tackles, 14 passes defensed, a sack and an interception while playing 94 percent of the Steelers' defensive snaps.

Those snaps were mostly run defense and coverage, per Pro Football Focus . Porter ranked top-five in the NFL in yards allowed per coverage snap last season, per PFSN .

Porter has not allowed a touchdown on a regular-season coverage snap since Week 8 of the 2023 season, per NFL Next Gen Stats cited by former NFL scout Matt Williamson .

His defensive efforts down the stretch were a key reason the Steelers made it into the playoffs before losing in the Wild Card round to the Houston Texans.

The Steelers responded to that playoff loss by bringing in McCarthy to replace longtime head coach Mike Tomlin this offseason.

McCarthy, who said in August he would like to coach Porter, will now hope to see his franchise make some more moves ahead of the deadline in order to bolster their secondary in Porter's absence.

articles.title: 49ers’ 2021 Decision Ranked the ‘Biggest NFL Draft Mistake’ of the Past 10 Years
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers’ decision to select Trey Lance with the No. 3 overall pick in the 2021 NFL Draft has been labeled one of the biggest draft mistakes o...
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers' decision to select Trey Lance with the No. 3 overall pick in the 2021 NFL Draft has been labeled one of the biggest draft mistakes of the past decade. The selection remains a major talking point because of the resources San Francisco surrendered to move up and the limited return it ultimately received from the quarterback.

The 49ers entered the 2021 draft holding the No. 12 pick before making a blockbuster trade with the Miami Dolphins to move into the top three . San Francisco sent multiple first-round selections and additional draft capital to acquire the opportunity to select a quarterback it believed could become the centerpiece of the franchise.

Lance arrived with considerable potential after starring at North Dakota State, where his combination of arm strength, athleticism and rushing ability made him one of the most intriguing prospects in the class. However, his transition to the NFL proved difficult, and injuries further complicated his development after he arrived in San Francisco.

The quarterback started only a handful of games for the 49ers before the organization eventually moved on.
